description: A load testing script for a mock server that performs concurrent HTTP GET requests to evaluate performance metrics such as response times, success rates, and throughput.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_request(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, url: str, username: str)
methods.description: Performs a single HTTP GET request to the specified URL with a username, measuring response time and handling potential exceptions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_load_test(base_url: str = "http://localhost:3001", concurrent_users: int = 10, requests_per_user: int = 10)
methods.description: Runs a load test by simulating multiple concurrent users making repeated requests to the server, then analyzes and returns performance metrics.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and executes the load test, printing formatted results to the console.
